project.name: eloup
project.intent: Multi-game ELO tracking website for parties. Mobile-first PWA. Discord OAuth, per-game and overall ratings, tournaments, hidden ELO-betting. Deployed to a shared Linode LKE cluster via ArgoCD GitOps.

architecture.description: Next.js (App Router) on Node 20 backed by SQLite via better-sqlite3, packaged as a single AMD64 container. Orchestrated on Kubernetes; manifests reconciled by ArgoCD; images published to DockerHub.

auth.description: Discord OAuth via next-auth. Sign-in requires verified email; the stable FK is the Discord user id (snowflake), never the handle. Roles: user, tournament_admin, global_admin. Match-result confirmation policy is unchanged pending Q-AUTH-2.

rating.description: Per-(player, game) ELO is the source of truth. Overall rating is its own independent ELO updated per match using the same algorithm. Floor at 0 — overall ELO cannot go below zero (bet losses or rating updates clamp). Team matches use a single team-average ELO update with equal delta to every team member (Q-RATE-2 default a).

deployment.description: Linode LKE cluster tow-c1 (us-sea-2), namespace eloup, host eloup.kodloki.io. Shine flat layout (K8s/*.yaml). Pushes mirror to gitea (haxley) and github; ArgoCD watches the canonical GitHub remote. Wizard ships as the bholcombe/eloup-wizard Docker image.

tournaments.description: Flat named groupings of matches with per-tournament delegated admins. Format is a single named-group model (no brackets in M5). Rating pool is shared with casual matches (same per-game and overall ELO tables). Invites are a single revocable shared-link token stored on the row; rotation = re-issue, revoke = NULL. The creator is a permanent super-admin per tournament (only a global_admin can demote them). tournament_admin is per-tournament authority derived from the tournament_admins table, not from players.role.

betting.description: Hidden ELO-betting on matches. Currency is overall ELO; wager is escrowed at placement (immediate debit) and settled when the match transitions pending → confirmed. Cap = max |per-game rating delta| among participants. Bets void on disputed/cancelled. Reveal mechanism, self-bet legality, and visibility are TBD.

app.description: Next.js 15 App Router PWA. Tailwind + hand-written components (no shadcn-CLI dependency); better-sqlite3 direct (no ORM) with versioned .sql migrations in lib/db/migrations/; Auth.js v5 for Discord OAuth (JWT sessions, trustHost: true for self-hosted ingress); hand-rolled service worker + manifest.webmanifest for PWA install; leaderboards are anonymous-visible (Q-APP-4 default).
